summary: Delta Air Lines filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $500 million senior unsecured notes offering: 5.500% Notes due November 6, 2029, priced at 99.855% of par for $499.275 million gross, a 0.500% underwriting discount and $496.775 million net proceeds before expenses. Interest pays semi-annually from May 6, 2027; the notes are callable and carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase right. Joint book-runners include BofA, Citigroup, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and Standard Chartered. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch leverage and refinancing terms.
